name: Crusch Karsten
japaneseName: クルシュ・カルステン
description: Crusch Karsten is the Matriarch of House Karsten and a candidate to become the 42nd monarch of Lugunica in the Royal Selection. A charismatic leader of noble conviction, she plays a major role in Arc 3 and Arc 10, as well as a supporting role in Arc 5.
